usedFor: Edits to a Notion page update the matching page in Prismic.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Content in Page” in Notion, then “Update Page” in Prismic
bestTemplate.why: Notion edits are the likeliest sign a Prismic page needs to change.

watchOut: “Update Page” saves a Prismic draft that still needs publishing, and it cannot create a new page.
